svg.title: Two voice calls beside 24 coding-agent sessions
svg.desc: RTX 5060 Ti: voice-to-voice p95 against an SLO of 2.03 s and the agents' tokens/s: Tuned vLLM 0.32, the baseline, 10.48 s and 3,305 tokens/s (100% of the first row's) over 10 runs; A router, aborts and resubmits, 2.52 s and 3,332 tokens/s (101% of the first row's) over 5 runs; #63350 and #63351, 48-token window, 2.24 s and 3,203 tokens/s (97% of the first row's) over 15 runs. A100-SXM4-80GB: voice-to-voice p95 against an SLO of 1.67 s and the agents' tokens/s: Tuned vLLM 0.32, for the RTX 5060 Ti, 4.99 s and 8,633 tokens/s (100% of the first row's) over 5 runs; #63350 and #63351, 48-token window, 1.63 s and 8,651 tokens/s (100% of the first row's) over 5 runs. A100-SXM4-80GB: voice-to-voice p95 against an SLO of 1.67 s and the agents' tokens/s: Tuned vLLM 0.32, the card's best, 3.66 s and 14,536 tokens/s (100% of the first row's) over 2 runs; #63350 and #63351, 48-token window, 1.83 s and 14,635 tokens/s (101% of the first row's) over 2 runs.
svg.text: tokens/s, % of the baseline • Higher is better
Each group's SLO is the p95 of voice alone on
its card, with as many callers, plus 250 ms.
